name: Mora
source:
A mysterious girl who saved [url=/c98942] Souta's[/url] life and now offers him a deal. 

Despite her small stature, she's a skilled vampire hunter.

[Spoiler]She's a [Url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dhampir]dhampir[/url] herself and wants to exterminate all vampires from the face of the earth.[/spoiler]
